fields.label: Feature: Pause / resume threads
fields.description: Compile the 'Thread Pause' and 'Thread Resume' events, which freeze a thread by handle and continue it from the exact instruction where it stopped.

fields.label: Feature: Pause / resume actor update scripts
fields.description: Compile the 'Actor Pause Update Script' and 'Actor Resume Update Script' events, which do the same for an actor's On Update script addressed by actor index.

fields.label: Feature: Check thread state
fields.description: Compile the 'If Thread State' event, which branches on whether a thread is running, paused or terminated.

fields.label: Feature: Read thread count
fields.description: Compile the 'Get Thread Count' event, which stores how many of the engine's 16 thread contexts are currently in use.
